==Usage==
<code><nowiki>
{{Twitter|username=|url=|name=|date=|quote=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}
</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|username}} Twitter handle of the user, such as <code>HolocronKeeper</code>.
*{{Para|url}} URL to the tweet in question, such as <code>status/21161475288</code>.
*{{Para|name}} Actual name of the user, linked to Wookieepedia if possible, for example <code><nowiki>[[Leland Chee]]</nowiki></code>.

{{BackupLinkHelp}}

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|date}} The date the Tweet was posted online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} Users are encouraged to utilize the optional "quote" field in the template whenever possible, as Twitter posts are subject to permanent removal at any time.

===Example(s)===
Status:
<pre>
{{Twitter|username=HolocronKeeper|url=status/21161475288|name=[[Leland Chee]]|archivedate=20200406095105}}
</pre>

Produces:

{{Twitter|username=HolocronKeeper|url=status/21161475288|name=[[Leland Chee]]|archivedate=20200406095105}}

<hr />

User:
<pre>
{{Twitter|username=HolocronKeeper|name=[[Leland Chee]]|archivedate=20200602104818}}
</pre>

Produces:

{{Twitter|username=HolocronKeeper|name=[[Leland Chee]]|archivedate=20200602104818}}

<hr />

With quote:
<pre>
{{Twitter|username=HolocronKeeper|url=status/21161475288|name=[[Leland Chee]]|date=2010-08-14|quote=Yes, Stewjon will be in the Holocron.|archivedate=20200406095105}}
</pre>

Produces:

{{Twitter|username=HolocronKeeper|url=status/21161475288|name=[[Leland Chee]]|date=2010-08-14|quote=Yes, Stewjon will be in the Holocron.|archivedate=20200406095105}}

<hr />

With screenshot:

<pre>
{{Twitter|username=LandryQWalker|url=status/936701004048949248|name=[[Landry Q. Walker]]|date=2017-12-01|quote=Star Wars Adventures 4 - Meet Tadd Marteens. A farmer from Stewjon, Tadd is a new recruit who joined the rebellion after the victory at Yavin. A decent pilot with no combat experience, Tadd flies an A-Wing into battle.|archivefile=File:Tadd Marteens Tweet.png}}
</pre>

Produces:

{{Twitter|username=LandryQWalker|url=status/936701004048949248|name=[[Landry Q. Walker]]|date=2017-12-01|quote=Star Wars Adventures 4 - Meet Tadd Marteens. A farmer from Stewjon, Tadd is a new recruit who joined the rebellion after the victory at Yavin. A decent pilot with no combat experience, Tadd flies an A-Wing into battle.|archivefile=File:Tadd Marteens Tweet.png}}
